dogecoin.text: @elonmusk @dogecoin  was a joke, @elonmusk has followed the joke, but with a marked personal touch and apparently wants to show that his influence is capable of putting Doge, a currency that does not have much to contribute, above of @Bitcoin.  #elonrelax, don't cross to dark side, please.
